name: Hyperconsciousness
description: Developer-alpha encrypted, append-only knowledge store with a Rust CLI and stdio MCP server for search and retrieval through scoped, expiring grants. Build from source; requires an initialized local store and an owner-issued grant.
examples: Build from source: git clone https://github.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness.git; cd hyperconsciousness; cargo build --release --locked
After initializing an isolated store and creating a scoped grant as documented in the README, configure the absolute hc executable with args: mcp --as <grant-id> --dir <absolute-store-path>.

requirements.other: Rust 1.88.0 via rustup to build from source. Linux also needs the native development headers documented in the README. Runtime requires a local HC store and a scoped grant.

features: MCP search, recent records, record retrieval and file tools
